## Overview
HP Inc. is a global provider of personal systems, printers, peripherals, device services, and hybrid-work technology. Vendor analysis should focus on device refresh cycles, print fleet economics, endpoint security, and managed device services.

## Key Takeaways
- PC demand is tied to enterprise refresh cycles and hybrid-work hardware needs
- Print revenue depends on supplies, managed print services, and device fleet optimization
- Security and lifecycle services are important differentiators in enterprise device deals
- Procurement leverage is strongest around volume, warranties, support, and bundled services

## Highlights
- Enterprise buyers can negotiate across laptops, workstations, monitors, printers, and services
- Managed print contracts should include usage transparency and consumables controls
- Device refresh planning can reduce support costs and improve endpoint security

## Investment Focus Areas
- **Products**: EliteBook, Z workstations, Poly devices, LaserJet, managed print
- **AI & Cloud**: AI PCs, endpoint management, hybrid-work collaboration devices
- **Strategic Priorities**: Device lifecycle services, security, hybrid work, print profitability
